title: Terry Lovelace's 'Dr Bug' abduction told at 2018 conference
summary: John Blitch tells of Terry Lovelace's 'Dr Bug' abduction told at 2018 conference, about 2018 (telling); camping trip earlier at Whiteman Air Force Base area; conference venue, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Whiteman Air Force Base area; conference venue

tellings.quote: when he told the story about being on a table and Dr bug comes over and start and he's screaming as loud as he can and Dr bug looks over at him and says stop screaming

plain: John Blitch, introduced on a podcast as a scientist from DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, tells the podcast host Jesse Michels about a talk he heard at a conference in 2018. There, according to Blitch, a man named Terry Lovelace described being abducted after an earlier camping trip near Whiteman Air Force Base. Lovelace said he was lying on a table, screaming as loud as he could, when a being he called "Dr Bug" walked over, looked at him and told him to stop screaming. If true, it would mean someone had been held and examined by a non-human being.
